people.imagined: Dawn on the rocks of the sun-bathing island. He sits barefoot on wet black stone mending a net, a small brown old man with nothing about him to notice, until he lifts his head and turns his eyes on the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated barefoot on wet black rock at dawn with a fishing net across his knees, he has just lifted his head and looks straight at the viewer. Face: a small, narrow, deeply brown face seamed like dried fruit; thin white brows; a short nose; a soft mouth in a mild half-smile; a wisp of white beard; and the eyes, the most important thing: large, clear and unnaturally bright, the irises banded in five colours, thin rings of pale gold, green, deep blue, red and brown, drawn big and plain. Hair: thin white hair tied in a knot with a strip of sea-grass. Body: small, wiry, bent, barefoot. Clothing: the robes of a hidden immortal made to look like a fisherman's, layers of indigo and sea-grey silk with a worn, faded softness, two crossed collars, wide sleeves with neat darker reinforcing squares at the elbows stitched in silver thread, a string of sea-polished pebbles and white jade at the neck. Hands and objects: gnarled brown hands hold a half-mended net and a bone needle; on the rock at his side stands a plain unglazed clay vase the height of a forearm, beaded with cold dew; on a cord at the wrist hangs one small clear stone bead with a grain of sand held motionless in its centre. Power: a vast, quiet aura, faint rings of all five elements, gold, green, blue, red and brown, drifting like soft motes around him and the vase. Background: a pale sea, a low sun, a dark rock edge, a faint ring of light beyond the horizon. Light: soft pink spirit-light from the upper left, the vase cold blue-grey, a gentle rim light. Expression: a mild, patient half-smile, ancient and unhurried, with the banded eyes seeing far more than the face lets on.

people.imagined: Late afternoon at his corner table in the market. One cup stands untouched in front of him; he is watching the crowd with a long sad calm and has not yet drunk. The sword on his back shows a grey crane on its guard.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a corner table in a busy market with a full cup before him, watching the crowd, a long sword across his back. Face: a long, narrow, stooped face with a high forehead; weathered brown skin; deep lines running from nose to mouth; thin iron-grey brows; calm grey eyes, steady and a little sad; a long straight nose; a thin mouth closed; a short grey beard, neat. Hair: grey, long, tied back low with a silver cord and a plain silver pin, a few strands at the temple. Body: tall, thin, stooped, long-limbed, sitting very still. Clothing: the long robes of a wandering sword immortal, flowing layered silk in many different shades of grey cut from panels so the garment reads as a quiet patchwork of silvers and greys, two crossed collars with a faint cloud border embroidered in silver thread, wide sleeves, a gauze over-robe the colour of pale smoke, a faded silk cord belt. Hands and objects: both hands lie flat on the table either side of a small untouched cup of pale wine; behind his right shoulder rises the hilt of a long narrow sword, on its guard a small cut crane in grey metal, big enough to read; at the hilt a carved pale bone pendant in the shape of a bird's wing. Power: a cold silver aura, thin, sharp wisps of metal qi curling from the blade and a few silver motes in the air. Background: a blurred market, awnings, hanging lanterns, a stall of pots, soft mist. Light: warm late-afternoon spirit-light from the upper left with a cool silver rim along the blade. Expression: a quiet, long-patient look, the calm grey eyes a little sad and the thin mouth closed, a man waiting for a wind that will come at dusk.

people.imagined: At the stone lip of a pool at dusk. He sits with his head tilted as if someone is speaking very quietly, his burn-white eyes open on nothing, the lightning scar glinting down his neck. He is listening to a bell under the water.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a stone pool edge at dusk, his head tilted to one side as if listening to a whisper, his eyes white and open. Face: a broad, still, calm face; eyes completely burn-white, the irises gone, the whites pale and scarred, big and plain; heavy straight dark brows; a broad nose; a calm closed mouth; and, from the crown of his head down over the left temple, cheek, jaw and neck, a branching lightning scar, pale pink-white like a fern, running down to the collarbone, the second mark and clearly visible. Hair: dark and thin, short, burnt away along the scar line, a plain dark jade pin. Body: broad, heavy-shouldered, seated square and still. Clothing: flowing layered robes of dark indigo silk with deep blue-violet gauze over them, burnt through at both shoulders and left unmended, the burn-edged holes showing his bare shoulders, two crossed collars embroidered with faint wave patterns in dark silver, a rope-like sash with a dark jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands rest on his knees; beside him on the stone lies a small bronze hand mirror cast with waves on one half and mulberry rows on the other. Power: a blue-violet storm aura, fine threads of lightning crawling over the surface of the pool and along the scar, a few violet motes drifting up. Background: a still dark pool reflecting the last dusk sky, a hanging bell half under water, soft mist. Light: low blue dusk spirit-light from the upper left, the scar catching a pale highlight. Expression: head tilted, the white open eyes calm on nothing, a patient, listening stillness.

people.imagined: Remembered: the ice swordsman at the edge of a glacier at the hour he set out to find the oldest man alive, sword in hand, white breath, stubborn with trust.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of an ice swordsman at forty-five, standing on a frozen slope holding a pale blade point-down before him, his breath white. Face: a lean, sharp, wind-cut face; skin pale with a frost-burn pink on cheeks and nose; heavy straight dark brows; steady pale blue eyes; a straight nose; a firm mouth; short dark stubble with frost on it. Hair: black, to the shoulder, tied back with a white silk ribbon and a silver pin, frost glittering along it. Body: tall, lean and upright, broad in the shoulder, standing firm in the snow with his weight set down through the blade. Clothing: the flowing robes of an ice sword immortal, layered white and pale-blue silk with a long outer coat of silver-white fur-trimmed brocade, two crossed collars embroidered with snowflakes and cranes in silver, wide sleeves falling in long folds, a belt of braided white cord with a pale jade pendant; fur-lined gauntlets. Hands and objects: both hands rest on the pommel of a long slender sword whose blade looks like clear glacier ice, with a thin pale-blue shine, point down in the snow. Power: a strong ice-blue aura, drifting motes of frost and a ring of rime spreading from the blade over the snow. Background: a vast blue-white glacier rolling away in long cracked folds, a pale sky, far dark mountains, one line of his boot prints in the snow behind him. Light: cold clear spirit-light from the upper left with a glowing blue rim. Expression: a quiet, resolute, trusting look, the pale blue eyes steady and the firm mouth set, a man who has chosen to meet heaven with empty hands. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: Remembered: the alchemist at her three-legged furnace in violet smoke, lifting the lid to smell, certain of her last pill, with a dyer's stained fingers.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the great alchemist at forty, lifting the lid of a violet bronze furnace and sniffing the rising smoke. Face: a refined, intelligent, narrow face; skin pale with a faint warm flush; eyes half-closed in concentration, long lashes; thin arched brows; a fine straight nose lifted slightly; a small mouth with a satisfied curve; a faint purple stain on the chin. Hair: black, in a high elaborate knot with two jade pins and a red hairpin, a loose strand at the temple. Body: slim, graceful, bending slightly forward. Clothing: a long robe of deep crimson silk dyed in layers from rose to rust at the hem, two crossed collars embroidered with flame and herb-leaf borders in gold thread, wide sleeves tied back with silk cords, a pale gauze over-robe, a sash with a red jade pendant and long tassels. Hands and objects: the fingers of both hands are stained in dye colours, purple, red and yellow to the second joint; the right hand holds the lid of a three-legged bronze furnace gone violet with age, purple smoke curling up past her sleeve. Power: a rich violet-red aura, glowing motes of herb-spirit rising with the smoke and a soft ring of light round the furnace. Background: shelves of jars and bundled herbs rising behind her into dim beams, a paper window with a bright square of sky, a low table of mortars and scales, a faint curl of smoke along the ceiling. Light: warm spirit-light from the upper left, lit from below by purple smoke glow. Expression: an absorbed, certain, hungry look, the eyes half-closed in a long inhale and the small mouth curving with satisfaction. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: Remembered: the fire cultivator at a volcanic vent mouth, fanning a red fan at the heat, impatient, eager to go deeper.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a fire cultivator at thirty-five, standing at a glowing vent in black rock, fanning himself with a red fan, grinning with eagerness. Face: a young, sharp, sunburnt face; bright orange-brown eyes; thick dark brows; a hooked nose; a wide eager grin; soot on one cheek. Hair: dark red-brown, spiky, tied with a red silk cord and a small copper pin, singed at the tips. Body: lean, strong, a miner's shoulders; his stance is wide and eager, one foot on a ledge of black rock and the knee bent, leaning toward the glow; sweat has darkened his neckline and made the hair stick to his brow. Clothing: a short robe of rust-red silk open at the chest over a flame-orange under-robe, two crossed collars trimmed with dull-gold flame embroidery, wide sleeves caught up with scorched silk bracers, a heat-darkened sash with a red jade pendant; soot on the backs of his hands; boots. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a fan with red iron ribs and a fire-silk face painted with flame shapes, no writing, lifted; the left points down into the vent. Power: a bright ember-orange aura, sparks and curls of heat drifting up from his sleeves. Background: a steep slope of glassy black rock, a long crack in the earth glowing bright orange with white heat at its centre, curls of pale steam, a broken ledge with a rope tied to a spike, a low smoky sky reddened from below. Light: strong orange vent glow from the lower right and an ember rim light. Expression: an impatient, brave, fierce look, the eyes narrowed against the heat and the jaw set, a young man in a hurry to burn brightly. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: Remembered: the swordswoman on a river road at dusk, a jade flute at her lips, playing the falling-plum tune before a duel, plum blossoms drifting.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a swordswoman at thirty-eight, playing a pale jade flute with her eyes closed on a river bank under falling plum petals. Face: an open, handsome, sun-browned face; closed eyes; strong dark brows; a straight nose; a relaxed mouth at the flute; a small scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, in a loose high tail tied with a green silk ribbon and a jade pin, a plum blossom behind the ear. Body: tall, lean, easy, broad-shouldered, her weight on her back foot as if about to step into a dance, the elbows lifted as the flute rises, chest high with breath. Clothing: the flowing robe of a roaming sword immortal, deep river-blue silk fitted at the waist, a standing collar and a second pale collar beneath, wide sleeves and long skirts that stir in the wind, plum blossoms embroidered along the borders in white and pink thread, a scarlet silk sash with a jade pendant; a short curved knife slung at her back in a plain scabbard; a plum branch lies at her feet. Hands and objects: both hands hold a slender pale-green jade flute to her lips; the flute's end shows a thin blade line. Power: a gentle white-pink glow of music, petals circling her as if carried by the sound. Background: a wide silver river, a sampan with a single lantern, small white petals falling in the air and scattered on the water, a low city of tiled roofs far off in dusk haze, a rising pink-gold sky. Light: golden dusk spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light. Expression: a relaxed, generous, careless calm, the eyes closed and the lips on the flute, a faint smile on a woman at ease with the world. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: Remembered: the water master walking out over a vast still lake toward a huge pale moon, not looking back, his reflection under every step.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a water master of forty-five walking away over a still moonlit lake, seen three-quarters from behind with his face turned a little back, his steps leaving ripple rings. Face: a calm, plain, lean face turned in profile; closed-looking calm eyes; level brows; a straight nose; a gentle mouth; a short grey-black beard. Hair: long black hair loose down the back, hanging completely still despite the faint wind, held by a single plain white jade pin. Body: tall, slender and straight, walking unhurriedly with his arms loose and his head turned slightly back so the profile is clear. Clothing: a long flowing robe of pale water-grey silk over layers of silver-white gauze, wide sleeves that fall in long folds, no ornament or border at all, the hem resting on the water without wetting, a plain silk belt; a faint shimmer like moonlit water runs through the cloth. Hands and objects: both hands hang open at his sides. Power: a vast, calm blue-silver aura, ripple rings of light spreading in perfect circles, one behind each footfall, and pale motes like drops hanging above the water. Background: an endless flat black lake under a huge pale full moon low over the water, its reflection a straight path of silver from his feet to its centre; behind him on the dim far shore a tiny shrine with a single lamp and a small dark figure kneeling; the sky deep blue-black and clear of cloud. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left, a soft glowing rim. Expression: a serene, content look in profile, the calm eyes half closed and the gentle mouth almost smiling. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: Remembered: the last disciple on a small boat in a grey western sea, holding a bronze mirror up to the water, looking for sails that are gone.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a seafarer-scholar at forty-five standing in a small boat, holding a bronze hand mirror up before the sea, looking intently into it. Face: a lean, stubborn, weather-darkened face; deep-set grey eyes narrowed in a search; thick straight brows; a long nose; a firm mouth; a short grey-streaked beard. Hair: black with grey, tied up in a topknot with a silver pin, a scrap of blue silk round the brow. Body: tall, lean and wiry, standing braced in the rocking boat with his knees soft and his shoulders square. Clothing: the flowing robe of a scholar-immortal, layered sea-blue and deep-teal silk, salt-whitened at the hem, two crossed collars embroidered with waves and small ships in silver thread, wide sleeves whipped by the wind, a gauze over-robe the colour of sea mist, a sash with a pale jade pendant; a satchel of scrolls on the shoulder. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a bronze mirror whose back is cast with waves on one half and mulberry rows on the other, its face turned toward him; the left hand grips the mast, the knuckles white. Power: a faint sea-blue glow gathers in the mirror and a few pale motes of light drift off its edge. Background: a grey sea under a grey sky, a small boat with its brown sail furled, a ghostly faint line of sails far off in the mist. Light: pale silver spirit-light from the upper left, a thin glowing rim. Expression: a patient, haunted, determined stare into the mirror, the deep-set grey eyes narrowed and the firm mouth held shut, looking for something he is afraid to find. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: On the little jetty at dusk, the boat tied up behind him, he is writing in a book on his knee with ink-stained fingers, glancing up at the old man's rock, deciding what the old man would have said.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a jetty with a book in silk wrap open on his knee, brush in hand, glancing up at something out of frame. Face: a lean, sun-black face; sharp cheekbones; thoughtful dark eyes; strong straight brows; a long nose; a mouth held tight over a decision; a thin line of grey in a short beard. Hair: black, tied back in a knot with a blue silk cord and a plain dark jade pin. Body: lean, wiry, a rower's shoulders, sitting hunched. Clothing: a fine robe of deep sea-blue silk, sleeves tied at the wrist with silver cord, two crossed collars with a quiet wave border embroidered in darker thread, a pale gauze over-robe the colour of sea mist, rolled trousers and bare feet, a sash with a blue jade pendant and a ledger wrapped in blue silk hanging from it. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush, every fingertip stained deep black with ink; the left holds the open book, its pages ruled with columns of small drawings, no writing. Power: a calm blue-teal aura, a few drops of water-light rising from the page. Background: a small boat bobbing at the jetty's foot, a darkening sea, and far away on a rock a seated tiny figure, a pilgrim waiting. Light: low orange dusk spirit-light from the upper left, the page glowing warm, a cool blue rim. Expression: a careful, conflicted, calculating look, the eyes lifted from the page and the mouth held tight over a decision he has not yet made.

people.imagined: On the herb mountain, bending over a cassia bed in the evening light, her basket on her back, tasting a leaf; she is in the middle of deciding something about someone far away.
people.subject: The moment: bending over a bed of dark-leaved cassia with a leaf between her fingers, about to taste it, a big basket on her back. Face: a small, narrow, grey, wrinkled face; very bright black eyes; thin grey brows; a sharp small nose; a thin mouth parting to taste; a faint patient smile of a woman making a record. Hair: grey, pulled into a tight small bun held by a green jade pin under a pale cinnamon silk headcloth low over her brow. Body: small, thin and bent, quick; she leans from the waist with her free hand on her knee, the basket's strap biting into her shoulder. Clothing: the robe of an old herb immortal, fine cinnamon-brown and pale-green silk with the hem dyed deep cinnamon, two crossed collars embroidered with cassia leaves and small flowers in gold thread, sleeves tied back, a pale gauze over-robe, a green silk sash with a small bronze scale in a case, a green jade pendant and a bundle of pill-papers tied with thread, unmarked. Hands and objects: both hands are stained deep cassia-brown to the wrist, large in the picture; the right pinches a leaf; the basket on her back overflows with green and red herbs. Power: a soft green-gold aura of wood qi and drifting leaf-shaped motes in the air round her hands. Background: terraces of herb beds rising up the mountain in even rows, dark glossy cassia bushes, a small steaming pond with a bamboo pipe, a distant slate roof with a plume of smoke, a boy with a basket, small and blurred, in the next row. Light: warm gold evening spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a shrewd, watchful, patient half-smile, the bright black eyes fixed on the leaf as if making a record of it.

people.imagined: At night on a bare peak, the wind changing, she stops mid-sentence with her head turned, the flute at her belt, one hand on its end like a sword hilt.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a bare mountain peak at night, head snapping toward a change in the wind, one hand on the end of the bamboo flute at her belt. Face: a long, lean, bony face with high cheekbones; skin brown and wind-scoured; sharp watchful grey eyes; thin straight brows; a long straight nose; a mouth pressed shut mid-word. Hair: black, in a long single braid blown sideways by the wind, the end tied with a grey silk cord and a small silver ring. Body: tall, long-boned and narrow-hipped, balanced on the balls of her feet at the very edge of the peak, her cloak and braid streaming. Clothing: a long flowing robe of mine-grey silk over a paler grey under-robe, two crossed collars embroidered with mountain ridges in dark silver, wide sleeves whipped sideways, a gauze scarf of dark smoke-colour at the throat, a sash with a grey jade pendant, fine grey gloves. Hands and objects: the right hand grasps the end of a bamboo flute thrust through her belt like a sword, as if to draw it; the left lifts, fingers spread, to test the wind. Power: pale golden-grey motes of earth and metal qi stream with the wind round her hand. Background: a black rock edge falling away into a huge starry sky, the peak's bare crown, and low at the left a faint grey door set in the rock, half in shadow. Light: cold starlight and a pale low moon from the upper left, a thin silver rim along her cheek and braid. Expression: an alert, guarded, lonely look, the grey eyes snapped toward the wind and the mouth pressed shut mid-word.

people.imagined: On the prow of a fishing boat in a squall, describing the sea out loud to nobody, one arm stretched out with the fern-shaped lightning scars lit by a far flash.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a boat prow in wind and spray, one arm thrust out toward the sea, mouth open as she describes it aloud. Face: a wiry, sharp, windburnt face; lips cracked and white with salt; bright, hard, greedy dark eyes; thin brows; a short nose; a wide mouth open mid-word. Hair: short black salt-stiff hair with a thin silver ring at one ear. Body: wiry, tough and lean, knees bent and feet planted in the pitch of the deck, the right arm shot out ahead and the whole body leaning into the wind, the throat bared and corded. Clothing: a short sea-blue silk jacket with two crossed collars and a thin wave border embroidered in silver, wide trousers of pale blue silk, a band of sailcloth-coloured silk round the waist and a cord belt with a small brass bell and a blue jade pendant; the right sleeve cut off at the shoulder so the scarred arm is bare. Hands and objects: the right arm, bare, is covered from shoulder to wrist in a pink-white fern-pattern of lightning scars, big and plain; the left hand grips a stay rope, the fingers cracked and salt-white. Power: faint violet-white lightning threads dance along the scarred arm and blue spray-motes cling to her. Background: a black sea heaving in high grey-green swells, white spray streaming off the bow, a low line of cloud split by a distant fork of violet-white lightning, a small sail straining, and on the stern a grey-haired boatman crouched at the tiller. Light: dim stormy spirit-light from the upper left, a purple lightning flash on her profile. Expression: a fierce, boastful, exhilarated look, the salt-cracked lips drawn wide mid-word and the hard dark eyes gleaming, a girl in love with the storm.

people.imagined: At the tavern door on the first dawn of spring, laughing across the market square, a cup poured and held out, resin on her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a tavern door at dawn holding out a small wine cup in both hands with a big laugh. Face: a round, rosy, quick face; sparkling brown eyes; arched brows; a small nose; a wide laughing mouth; dimples; a smudge of pale resin on the cheek. Hair: brown, in a thick knot with a pine twig and a jade pin tucked in. Body: round, quick, curvy, shoulders shaking with the laugh, her whole weight leaning out of the doorway, arms bare to the elbow. Clothing: a fine green-brown silk jacket with two crossed collars embroidered with pine needles in gold thread, the cuffs sticky and gold-streaked with pine resin, plainly; a pale gauze over-sleeve; a white silk apron with a small red embroidered flower, a bright red sash with a green jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands hold out a small white cup of pale wine, steam rising; behind her a row of dark jars. Power: a soft green-gold glow in the steam and a few pine-green motes drifting out of the cup. Background: the tavern's low wooden interior with rows of dark jars on shelves and a lantern; across the square the farewell pavilion with red lanterns lit in the pale dawn and the shapes of early market sellers setting out baskets; a tall grey figure sits at a corner table, blurred. Light: pink dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim light on her cheek. Expression: a warm, merry, sly laugh, the eyes crinkled and the wide mouth open, a host already plotting the next joke over the cup.

people.imagined: Midday in the herb yard. He is sleepy over a grinding stone, wiping his flattened nose on the back of his wrist, then on his sleeve, with an easy lazy smile.
people.subject: The moment: sleepy over a grinding stone at midday, wiping his nose on the back of his wrist. Face: a round, soft, good-natured face; a flattened, crooked nose with an old break that never set straight, drawn big; heavy-lidded eyes half closed; thick brows; a slack friendly mouth. Hair: brown, tousled, held by a loose silk cord, a herb sprig in it. Body: stocky, soft and slouched, his elbow on the table and his chin almost on his hand, the belly pressing against the table's edge, one eye nearly closed; the flattened nose is shiny where he has rubbed it. Clothing: a loose, clean robe of soft brown silk with a pale green under-collar and two crossed collars with a thin herb-leaf border, wide sleeves rolled back, a pale silk apron stained green at the front; at his belt a bundle of small pill-papers tied with thread, a gourd and a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right wrist swipes at the nose; the left hand rests on a stone pestle in a stone mortar of green paste. Power: a faint green glow of wood qi lifts from the paste in a few motes. Background: a bright, sunny herb yard with racks of drying leaves, a clay stove with a small pot, baskets of grey-green roots, a pale path down the mountain, a boy carrying a basket in the blur, a few bees circling the mortar, light mist. Light: bright midday spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light. Expression: a slack, sleepy, good-natured look, the heavy lids half down and the loose mouth ready to give away whatever he has.

people.imagined: On a frost road, keeping his left hand in his sleeve while he unrolls a map with the other, an eager hard look in his eye at a far white peak.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a snowy road, one hand in his sleeve, the other unrolling a map, eyes on a far peak. Face: a lean, hungry, sharp face; keen pale blue eyes; thin brows; a sharp nose; a thin tight mouth; a short thin stubble; chapped skin. Hair: black, tied in a knot with a silver pin, rimed with frost. Body: lean and hunched against the cold, the left arm held tight across his chest and the hidden hand half-withdrawn into the sleeve. Clothing: a long fur-collared coat of fine grey-blue brocade over layered pale-blue and white silk, a high wolf-fur collar, two crossed collars embroidered with ice-flowers in silver thread, wide sleeves with leather cuffs, the left sleeve held across the body; a silk scarf wound twice round his throat. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a large map with small drawn mountains and a red dot, no writing, its edge flapping in the wind; the left hand, half out of its sleeve, shows three fingers whose tips are gone, the remaining nails white and ridged, clearly drawn. Past the right shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a narrow straight sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Power: a thin ice-blue aura and a few frost motes curl from the blade. Background: a snow road running up a long white slope toward a pale blue peak with a hazy crown of cloud, footprints leading away behind him, a dark line of pines at the left. Light: cold white spirit-light from the upper left, hard on his reddened cheeks, a glowing blue rim. Expression: an eager, hungry, ambitious look, the keen pale eyes fixed on the peak and the thin mouth tight with wanting it.

people.imagined: Sitting beside a hot spring in the cold, singed brows pulled down, she looks over a pilgrim's face and decides before they speak.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged beside a steaming vent, singed eyebrows low, looking hard at someone out of frame. Face: a lean, hard, flushed face; eyebrows singed to short black stubble, big and plain; dark narrow eyes; a hooked nose; a thin mouth that has already decided; red-pink cheeks from the heat. Hair: black, tied up under a rust-red silk cloth with a copper pin, a few singed ends. Body: wiry and upright, sitting straight with her ankles crossed and her hands gripping her knees, the head angled forward so the gaze comes up hard from under the singed brows; her cheeks red with the heat while her hands stay pale. Clothing: a robe of rust-red quilted silk, quilted in tight diamonds with a stiff high collar and a second crossed collar embroidered with flame in gold thread, a flame-orange gauze over-sleeve, a black belt carrying a small iron pot on a hook and a red jade pendant; fingerless gloves of grey silk. Hands and objects: both hands rest on her knees beside a small black pot with a lid; steam rises from the vent. Power: a steady ember-orange aura, sparks and curls of heat rising round her shoulders. Background: black volcanic rock steaming and glowing at its cracks, vents hissing white clouds, a few scattered pilgrims' stones in a circle, sleet slanting across the frame in thin grey lines, and a small bundle left by a previous visitor lying untouched at the edge. Light: orange spirit-light from the vent below with a glowing red rim. Expression: a cold, level, decisive glare, the thin mouth set and the dark eyes unmoved, a woman who has already made up her mind about the one in front of her.

people.imagined: Asleep standing, then awake, on a ledge with the empty sky, a gap-toothed whistle on his every word, seabird droppings dried on his shoulders like epaulettes.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a rock ledge looking up at an empty sky, lips pursed round a whistle through a missing front tooth. Face: a long, lazy, tanned face; half-closed hopeful eyes; thick brows; a missing upper front tooth visible in a small round whistling mouth; stubble. Hair: sun-bleached brown, held by a loose blue silk cord, a gull feather tucked behind his ear. Body: lanky and slouched, sitting with his knees drawn up and his spine slumped against the rock, the head tilted back so the long throat shows, the sky reflected in the pale eyes. Clothing: a long robe of soft brown silk gone pale at the cuffs with years of wear, the sleeves a little short, with a pale-blue under-collar and a faint wave border, a silk rope belt looped twice round his waist; on both shoulders crusts of dried white seabird droppings arranged like epaulettes, plainly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long wooden whistle-pipe; the left lifts to shade the eyes. Power: a faint blue sea-mist aura and a few pale motes drifting upward after the whistle. Background: a cracked slab of grey rock above a drop to the sea; seabirds standing in rows on the ledges below, nests in the crevices, thin white streaks on the rock, a vast pale sky with one very high thin cloud and nothing else. Light: bright pearly spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light. Expression: a dreamy, idle, hopeful look, the half-closed eyes on the empty sky and the lips pursed round the whistle, a man who can wait.

people.imagined: At the oars of the pilgrims' boat, deciding by whim, looking a would-be passenger up and down with a wet cropped head and no intention of rowing them yet.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at the oars of a small boat, arms folded across them, scrutinising someone out of frame, her cropped hair dripping. Face: a freckled, bright, impish face; wet short black hair plastered flat; sharp brown eyes; arched brows; a snub nose; a mouth pursed to refuse. Hair: cropped very short, soaking wet. Body: wiry, strong shoulders, her back straight and feet braced on the thwart, chin lifted; a bead of water runs down her nose. Clothing: a short river-blue silk jacket open over a pale silk under-shirt, with a thin wave border at the collar and cuffs in white thread, trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet, a silk cord belt carrying a small bone whistle; a red ribbon tied round her left wrist. Hands and objects: both hands lie over two oars; each palm bears a wide round callus, as big as a coin, shown plainly. Power: none; a few drops of water glint like small lights. Background: the boat sits on grey-green water with a small slapping wave at its side, a rope trailing to a wooden post, a dark island rock with a tiny seated figure on top, mist hanging low over the water, and on the jetty a boy in a wide hat waiting. Light: soft grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim light on her wet hair. Expression: a saucy, appraising squint with one brow cocked and the lips pushed to a smirk, a boatwoman sizing up her passenger and finding a price for him.

people.imagined: At the door of the market, tired from the road, coughing into her sleeve, plum petals still in her hem, deciding to ask the old swordsman anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a market lane, coughing into her sleeve, then looking up with a stubborn set face toward a figure at a table out of frame. Face: a thin, pale, determined face; flushed cheeks; large dark honest eyes; strong straight brows; a small nose; a firm young mouth. Hair: black, in two braids tied with white silk ribbons. Body: thin, small, held upright against the cough, the thin shoulders shaking then straightening, her jaw jutted forward. Clothing: a white-grey quilted silk coat with a high collar and big carved wooden toggles, a pale second collar beneath, a thin border of plum blossoms embroidered in soft pink thread, the hem dragging a trail of pink-white plum petals pressed flat by the road; a small wooden practice sword, a plain stick of pale wood with its grip wound in red cord, through her belt. Hands and objects: the left sleeve at her mouth; the right fist clenched. Power: none; a few pale pink petals drift in the air round her. Background: a narrow, busy market lane with awnings, hanging lanterns, a stall of grey pots and a seller of hot buns steaming in the cold, a tall stooped man in a grey coat seated at a far corner table in the blur, soft winter mist. Light: grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on her braids. Expression: a tired, stubborn, determined face, the mouth set hard after the cough and the eyes lifted straight at the figure, refusing to look as weak as she feels.

people.imagined: In the cassia bed with a basket, three bees on his shoulder and one on his hat, picking carefully, grinning at the sun.
people.subject: The moment: picking leaves from a cassia bed with a basket on his arm, bees circling his head and resting on his shoulders. Face: a round, trusting, freckled face; bright eyes; a snub nose; a wide grin. Hair: brown, curly, a bee on it. Body: slight, quick, standing with a slight lean to one side, the basket on the left arm and the right hand reaching up, a bee on the back of his wrist which he ignores; his light freckled face is turned up. Clothing: a cinnamon-brown silk robe with a plain pale collar and a thin gold-brown cassia-leaf border, the sleeves stained a deeper brown to the elbow, a woven belt and a light bamboo hat hanging at his back by a silk cord; his feet are bare and dusty. Hands and objects: the right hand picks a leaf; the left carries a basket of green leaves; five bees in the air. Power: a faint warm gold-green shimmer round the bees like drifting motes. Background: cassia bushes standing in rows, dark and glossy with small yellow flowers, a low wall of grey stones, the thatched roof of a hut, a cloud of bees rising golden in the sun, and in the distance a small grey woman bent over a bed, watching him with folded hands, soft mist. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on his curls. Expression: a broad, happy, unbothered smile with the eyes half closed in pleasure, bees crawling on his shoulders and not a flinch.

people.imagined: In a leaking hired boat, bent double by forty crossings, bailing with a cup, her white braid new for the spring, still looking ahead.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in a small wooden boat, bailing water with a wooden cup, her face lifted toward the far island. Face: a small, deeply lined brown face; faded eyes fixed ahead; thin white brows; a small nose; a patient, set mouth. Hair: a thick rope of white hair braided freshly and tied with a red thread. Body: small, bent double with age, thin-armed, sitting hunched with her knees together and her back bowed like a bent bow, the shoulders high; her eyes never leave the island. Clothing: a plain, clean dark-blue quilted silk jacket with matching reinforcing cloth at the elbows, a pale second collar, a grey silk scarf folded on her shoulders, a faded blanket over her knees, a silk rope belt; simple and mortal, but neat and soft. Hands and objects: the right hand bails with a wooden cup; the left grips the gunwale; her hands are small, brown and gnarled; the white braid with its red thread lies over her shoulder; around her feet an inch of water. Power: none; only a faint pale light on the water round the boat. Background: the boat is old and low, water pooled around her sandals and a visible dark crack along one plank; the grey sea runs flat to a low green island under a pale mist, gulls turning overhead, a single sun-bleached oar trailing in the water. Light: pale grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on her white braid. Expression: a patient, set, stubborn look, the faded eyes fixed on the island and the mouth held in a firm line, a woman who has made this crossing for forty years and will make it again.
